# Meathill HSM (full)

Software-defined Hardware Security Module (HSM) based on Cloudflare Workers + KV.
Site: https://hsm.meathill.com
Repo: https://github.com/meathill/hsm

## Canonical Docs

- Chinese README: ./README.md → https://hsm.meathill.com/
- English README: ./README_EN.md → https://hsm.meathill.com/en/
- Dev notes (architecture why): ./DEV_NOTE.md
- Short AI index: ./llms.txt → https://hsm.meathill.com/llms.txt
- AI skill guide: ./SKILL.md → https://hsm.meathill.com/SKILL.md
- Cursor MCP config: ./mcp.json → https://hsm.meathill.com/mcp.json
- MCP discovery: /.well-known/mcp.json → https://hsm.meathill.com/.well-known/mcp.json

## Runtime & Tooling

- Runtime: Cloudflare Workers + KV
- Language: TypeScript
- Package manager: pnpm
- Framework: Hono
- Build static site: `pnpm build`
- Test: `pnpm test` or `pnpm test:ci`
- Local dev: `pnpm dev`
- Deploy production: `pnpm deploy` (wrangler deploy --env production)

## Core API

Base URL: your Worker URL (production: https://hsm.meathill.com)

### PUT /keys/:path

Store or overwrite a secret.

- Header: `X-HSM-Secret: <client-secret>`
- Header: `Content-Type: application/json`
- Body: `{ "value": "<secret-string>" }` (max 8192 chars)
- Success: `{ "success": true, ... }`
- Ownership: overwriting an existing key requires the same client secret that can decrypt the current envelope (else 403)

### GET /keys/:path

Read and decrypt a previously stored secret.

- Header: `X-HSM-Secret: <client-secret>`
- Success: `{ "success": true, "data": { "value": "<secret-string>" } }`
- Missing key → 404; wrong secret → 403

### DELETE /keys/:path

Delete a secret after ownership validation.

- Header: `X-HSM-Secret: <client-secret>`
- Success: `{ "success": true, ... }`
- Wrong secret → 403

Path may contain slashes (e.g. `my-app/user-1/token`). The Worker strips `/keys/` from the pathname to recover the logical path.

## Security Model

- KEK derived via HKDF from `CF_SECRET_PART` (server Part A) + `X-HSM-Secret` (client Part B) + random salt
- Envelope encryption with AES-GCM-256; key path used as AAD
- KV storage keys obfuscated with HMAC-SHA256(`INDEX_SECRET`, path)
- Zero-trust: server cannot decrypt without the client secret
- CORS enabled on `/keys/*` for direct browser access

## Required Worker Secrets

- `CF_SECRET_PART`: server-side secret part (Part A)
- `INDEX_SECRET`: HMAC secret for KV key-index obfuscation

## MCP Integration (Cursor)

Copy `mcp.json` into `.cursor/mcp.json`, then set:

- `HSM_BASE_URL`: your Worker URL
- `HSM_SECRET`: value sent as `X-HSM-Secret`

Stdio bridge: `scripts/hsm-mcp-stdio.mjs`
Tools: `hsm_put_key`, `hsm_get_key`, `hsm_delete_key`
serverInfo.name: `meathill-hsm`
